summary: The macOS 12 screen-capture fallback now starts RTCDesktopCapturer with the RTCDesktopSource selected in the Flutter source picker instead of silently creating a default-screen capturer.

checks.name: Selected source reaches legacy capturer
checks.observation: When ScreenCaptureKit is unavailable and a source was selected, getDisplayMedia now initializes RTCDesktopCapturer with that source. initWithDefaultScreen remains only for calls that provide no source.

checks.name: macOS release build
checks.observation: Built BOOHTACORD.app (92.4 MB). Xcode emitted its existing ld address/target-atom ambiguity warning; build succeeded.

checks.name: Runtime source selection
checks.observation: A macOS 12 device with multiple displays is needed to confirm the chosen secondary display is the captured source and that its complete frame is preserved.

checks.name: Profile resolution cap
checks.observation: This source-selection fix does not bound resolution in the legacy fallback or custom macOS window capture; verify and implement those paths separately.

remaining: Test macOS 12 with a non-primary display selected. Add an aspect-preserving source-resolution cap for the macOS 12 fallback and selected windows, then validate sender dimensions and all nine quality profiles on device.
